notes.heading: What turns in the Mount Top's bearing
notes.text: The circular spline. The Mount Top's 6810 takes the spline's Ø50h6 outside diameter over the spline's top {top_6810_on_spline} mm. The spline turns with the Stator Holder and the External Gear, so this bearing is the output's third support.

notes.heading: How J3's stack closes
notes.text: Three revised prints close the motor chain on the output chain: the End Cap, the Attach, and the Stator Holder, whose floor keeps the drive where the first two put it. The drop follows the motor body: measure it (008.3), set MOTOR_LEN, and print J3's Attach with the new j3_hub_drop.

notes.heading: The coupler does not fit its seat
notes.text: Seated full length in the wave generator's hub, as a tool sets it (008.3 step 10), the Wave Gen Coupler's 10.0 mm hex runs into the Flex Spline Cap: the room between the cap's top and the hub is {coupler_hex_room} mm. At that seat the motor's 24 mm shaft would also run {coupler_shaft_overrun} mm past the revised coupler's blind bore. Both are open with the reviewer; the clash check holds the hex as an exception meanwhile.

notes.heading: The tie-down
notes.text: Each all-thread stands on its Nut Holder's slot floor, through the trap nut, up through the Mount and the Mount Top, two nuts locked on top. Four M3 × 12 screws come up through the floor's counterbores into the End Cap's nuts.
